segments.oily: One reviewer in her 60s with ongoing oily skin says the product helps keep her skin clear over years of use; another notes it did not make her skin oily afterward, unlike other microdermabrasion treatments.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one dealing with severe winter dryness and makeup peeling, report the scrub removed dry flakes without irritation or added dryness.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as effective for pore congestion on cheeks, chin and hairline and gentle enough for combination/dehydrated skin, though one with combination oily/dryness needed it paired with other Mad Hippie products to see full results.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea or eczema, report no irritation and smoother, calmer skin, but one reviewer with sensitive skin says it caused white bumps and swelling and another developed a rash.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s+ describe it as gentle enough for mature skin while improving glow, softness and reducing fine lines and pore size.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically describe normal, non-problematic skin as the reviewer's stated baseline.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using this for aging concerns report smoother texture, reduced fine lines and a brighter, more youthful look, including one who felt it took years off her skin; no dissent noted for this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the product left skin hydrated, soft and non-flaky, including one who says it resolved severe winter dryness and makeup peeling.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers note no redness after use, including one who expected irritation from the grittiness but saw skin appear less red instead; no reports of increased redness were found.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive skin conditions (rosacea, eczema) report the product did not disrupt or irritate their barrier and even improved sensitivity over time; contrasted by one reviewer whose face swelled with white bumps after use.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for acne scars and dark spots report smoother, more even-looking skin and reduced visible bumpiness with continued use over weeks to months.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne or breakouts report fewer blackheads, cleared blemishes and small pimples improving, though two reviewers report the product clogged pores or caused cystic-type breakouts and one report of purging on first use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report it controls oil without making skin oilier afterward, though this is based on a small number of testimonials rather than broad consensus.
